thread:
Marta: quick heads-up — running the weekly KPI rundown now. noticed webinar -> demo conversion dipped from 12% to 7% monday. anyone else see this on their dashboards? :thinking:
Raj: saw that spike in raw leads but conversion fell. suspect routing change? linked the funnel: https://redwood-dashboard/internal/funnels/weekly
Jules: checking attribution window — looks like an attribution model flip on friday (last-touch -> time-decay) might be shifting what counts as demo-sourced.
Sam: wait which deploy flipped that? ops-bot, did we push any routing or tag changes last week?
ops-bot: deploy #2024.11.17 to inbound-router completed by Nikhil at 2024-11-17T09:12Z. config: routing.v2 enabled for campaign=webinar.
Nikhil: i rolled the routing change (split 80/20 new-path) to reduce latency — didn’t think it would affect demo attribution but possible.
Marta: can we get quick numbers on: a) leads on new-path vs old-path, b) demo conversion rate by path, c) UTM consistency?
Jules: pulling a quick sql slice now. sample query I ran:
```sql
select path, count(*) as leads, sum(demo_booked::int) as demos, round(sum(demo_booked::int)/count(*)::numeric,3) as conv
from inbound.leads
where created_at >= '2024-11-10' and campaign = 'webinar-x'
group by path;
```
Jules: preliminary: new-path: 2,140 leads -> 83 demos (3.9%); old-path: 430 leads -> 61 demos (14.2%). big delta.
Raj: wow. that explains the aggregated drop. routing is moving higher-value prospects to old-path? or maybe messaged differently. what’s the landing content for new-path vs old-path?
Sam: new-path has simplified hero copy (shorter form) — we A/B'd to reduce friction but maybe reduced demo intent.
Marta: okay this is messaging iteration bleeding into routing. action items: 1) revert routing to 50/50 for next 48h, 2) run a messaging audit on new-path hero, 3) add a dashboard breakpoint to show conv by path daily.
Nikhil: I can revert routing to 50/50 now. rolling back in 5.
ops-bot: change request submitted: inbound-router.split -> 50/50 for campaign=webinar-x. scheduled at 2024-11-17T10:03Z.
Raj: for the dashboard breakpoint — Jules can you add a small tile to weekly-kpis with path filter and conversion sparkline? keep it under the demo card.
Jules: yup I’ll add it. also recommending we track message copy version as a dimension (msg_version) so these experiments show up in attribution.
Marta: agree. also let's capture a small benchmark narrative for the launch doc — note that simplified hero reduced demo conversion by ~60% on new-path, but increased raw leads (signups) by 20%. tradeoff call for PMs.
Sam: i’ll sync with PM on tradeoff. quick ask: can we run a 1-week holdout where new-path gets the original hero? want to see retention/qualified lead diff.
Raj: propose: 7-day holdout, measure MQL->Demo, Demo->Paid conversion. if signal holds, we iterate messaging.
Marta: perfect. follow-ups: Jules add sql and sparkline, Nikhil revert now, Sam coordinate holdout and comms to sales, Raj will update KPI doc with numbers and note attribution model impact. i’ll draft the blurb for launch retrospective.
Nikhil: revert complete. monitoring conversion in realtime.
ops-bot: alert: funnel-anomaly detected for campaign=webinar-x at 2024-11-17T10:12Z — conv delta > 25%.
Marta: thanks team :thumbsup: we’ll review in tomorrow’s KPI sync but wanted to log here for visibility. anyone sees other weirdness ping me.
Sam: passing this to sales ops for FYI. tagging @SalesOps.
Raj: adding a short note to the weekly KPI email: "routing + messaging experiment impacted demo conversion; see thread"
Marta: +1. end.
